# EF Core Migration History and Schema Versioning

- Author: tinhpham260205@gmail.com
- Date: 2026-07-15

This technical manual contains details of the VietRAG system, including custom LLM integrations, document ingestion pipeline, database models, and transaction management via MoMo payment gateway.

Line 1: Technical spec item 0001 - The Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline operates by dividing documents into semantic chunks, generating vector embeddings using Gemini Embedding, and indexing them in MS SQL Server using cosine similarity helper methods in VectorHelper. System token usage limits are updated in realtime via SignalR ChatHub. Subscription packages are defined and processed using a MoMo callback handler.
